full_text:
Article 6 (Meetings of the Committee)
(1) The Chairperson shall convene and preside over meetings of the Committee.
(2) A meeting shall open with the attendance of a majority of incumbent members, and resolutions shall be adopted by the affirmative votes of a majority of members present.
